My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
If your tracking shows delivered but you don’t have the package, try these steps first:
Check with neighbors, household members, or a building concierge if you have one.
Look around your property for safe places where couriers sometimes leave parcels (porch, garage, parcel locker, side entrance).
Many packages are found this way after a “delivered” scan. 
Couriers can also mark packages as delivered before the final delivery attempt, so it’s recommended to wait up to 5 business days after the delivery scan before taking further action.
If you still can’t locate the package after that, you can ask to speak with the human support team in this chat so the situation can be reviewed.
